preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The number of edges provided matches m.

postconditions.description: The number of output vertices matches the count k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in selected_vertices)
postconditions.description: All selected vertices are valid indices within the graph.

postconditions.expression: all((u, v) not in edge_set and (v, u) not in edge_set for u, v in [(selected_vertices[i], selected_vertices[j]) for i in range(len(selected_vertices)) for j in range(i + 1, len(selected_vertices))])
postconditions.description: No two vertices in the selected set are connected by a directed edge (independent set property).

postconditions.expression: all(any((u, v) in edge_set or any((u, w) in edge_set and (w, v) in edge_set for w in range(1, n + 1)) for u in selected_vertices) for v in range(1, n + 1) if v not in selected_vertices)
postconditions.description: Every vertex not in the selected set is reachable from some vertex in the selected set in at most two moves.
